query: Definitive transactional adoption and initialization of arbitrary projects by an autonomous software factory
summary_executive: A native adoption gateway should isolate work with Git worktrees, separate factory-owned runtime files from project-owned governance, pin provenance by source commit and content digests, model updates as three-way ownership decisions, and fail closed on dirty state, drift, or missing deterministic validation.

sources.title: git-worktree Documentation
sources.summary: Official semantics for multiple working trees, locked worktrees, and porcelain status.

sources.title: Copier: Updating a project
sources.summary: Template updates retain prior answers/version and expose conflicts for review.

sources.title: SLSA v1.2: Verifying artifacts
sources.summary: Artifact verification binds digests to expected source, builder and parameters.

sources.title: Reusing workflow configurations
sources.summary: Reusable CI workflows can be centralized and pinned; commit SHA is the strongest immutable reference.

sources.title: Using GPT-5.4
sources.summary: Agent behavior should be shaped with explicit skills and repository instructions, with delegation and validation tuned to the task.

insights.key_insight: Adoption and task execution can start from committed state without carrying dirty edits from the user's checkout.
insights.architectural_implications: Create and lock a dedicated branch/worktree before any target write.
insights.future_reference_value: Use porcelain worktree data for machine-readable lifecycle management.

insights.key_insight: Safe updates need a remembered prior version so local changes can be distinguished from factory-owned unchanged files.
insights.architectural_implications: Classify each path as create, adopt, update, unchanged, preserve, or conflict using the prior lock.
insights.future_reference_value: A future template engine can use the same ownership state machine.

insights.key_insight: A bundle is trustworthy only when its content digests and source identity match declared provenance.
insights.architectural_implications: Write the lock last and verify every managed SHA-256 plus the source commit.
insights.future_reference_value: The lock can later be signed or emitted as formal provenance.
